name: confetti
title: Confetti
blurb: Canvas-based confetti emitter with customizable particles.
description: Wraps canvas-confetti library for imperative control. Renders a canvas and exposes fire() API to trigger confetti bursts with custom options.
use_when: Celebration moments (form submission, game completion), rewards, or interactive celebrations.
a11y: Canvas animation only; no interactive elements. Motion-heavy, no text alternative.
